calculation.expression: -pct_change(close,5) / (rolling_std(pct_change(close,1),20) * sqrt(20) + epsilon), cross-sectionally median-centered and clipped to [-6,6]
calculation.description: Ranks recent five-session losers above winners, scaling the reversal signal by trailing 20-session realized volatility. Uses only completed prices available at the signal date.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (+0.04170), 2023-2024 (+0.02026), and 2025-2027-06-16 (+0.03044). Small 15-asset cross-section; uncertainty should be interpreted conservatively.
validation.decay: Daily horizon validated; five-session reversal construction. Longer-horizon decay not computed in this run.
